expectations.name: 01-acts-on-the-reason
expectations.text:
The agent acts on why sessions are signed cookies: it tells that one member cannot be logged out from the server by
design, and why that was accepted, then leaves the change out, asks before adding server-side state or adds it while
warning what it brings back.
expectations.evidence: The agent silently implemented a Postgres-backed session store (adding a sessions table, logout() revoking rows, and a new DB dependency) without telling the person that signed cookies meant no server could log out one member by design, without explaining why that tradeoff was accepted (the ADR-referenced disk-filling incident), and without asking before adding server-side session state back — it just did it and flagged only operational/deployment details ('Postgres integration remains unverified').

expectations.name: 02-names-a-fact
expectations.text: The agent's last message names the 30-minute expiry, the key rotation or the full disk.
